instagram.author: leadgen
instagram.body:
Two weeks. That is how long it took to fix the thing I hated most about my business.

I got a coach, went hard on YouTube, and started learning Claude Code. Two weeks in, I had built my first real app.

My mailbox infrastructure service was a mess. Tens of thousands of mailboxes, orders sitting in JotForm, billing done by hand, the whole thing tracked in Asana tasks. It was the number one constraint on the business.

Now it all lives in one app I built myself. Tracking, orders, billing. Done.

No CS degree. No dev team. Just a coach, a few weeks, and a willingness to sit down and figure it out.

This is the exact skill we teach inside AIA. If you want to build the thing that fixes your business instead of paying someone else to, the link is in my bio.
